realBrowserGate.interpretation: A real report now exists after C2a.2 deployment, but it contains none of the C2a.2 install/observer diagnostic fields. The executing browser context is therefore still running pre-C2a.2 userscript code (or an already-loaded old control page). This is not evidence that the C2a.2 observer itself failed.

decision.reason: C2a.2 is deployed and byte-verified. A post-deploy real report was observed, but the executing browser context still lacks C2a.2 runtime fields. Do not enable C2b until a freshly executed 6.2.23/2.2.41 context reports observer evidence.
decision.nextGate: Observe a real report with installRevision=6.2.23 (or the integrated Bridge 2.2.41 context) and architectureMembershipRevision. Then require observer_ok/verified_snapshot matching the current catalog. verification_failed must be fixed before C2b.

stagedC2b.note: Validated C2b code remains unmerged. If activated after C2a.2, rebuild it from current main and use installation versions newer than 6.2.23/2.2.41.
